tool_summary: Runs a System V-style init script to manage a system service, commonly a wrapper around systemctl on modern systemd distributions.
platform_notes: Behavior varies by distribution; on systemd systems 'service' is typically a compatibility wrapper around systemctl. This ruleset targets Linux only.

rules.description: The stop and restart actions immediately affect a running service's availability, which can disrupt dependent processes or connections.

Runs an init script to control a system service. Typically requires root privileges for state-changing actions. Severity here reflects distribution-dependent behavior (see platform_notes, llm_confidence: medium) rather than an actively-evolving CLI surface -- exact behavior for actions other than stop/restart is less certain across distributions, so an unmatched invocation should surface for review.
